assertion_results.text: The plan determines feature-branch workflow mode (not direct-to-main) based on the atomicity constraints in the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md states 'Selected mode: `feature-branch`' with rationale citing two atomicity indicators: (1) 'Coordinated schema migrations' explaining that merging migration without code changes would break advisory queries and vice versa, and (2) 'Breaking API changes (internal)' noting the entity API surface change. It quotes the feature's non-functional requirement: 'All changes must land together: merging the migration without the code changes would break all advisory queries, and merging the code changes without the migration would reference a column that does not exist.'

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type create-branch is generated as the first task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-1-create-feature-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\ncreate-branch' and is Task 1 (first task). summary-comment.md confirms: '| 1 | Create feature branch TC-9005 from main | trustify-backend | main | Bookend (create-branch) |'

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type merge-branch is generated as the last task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-8-merge-feature-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\nmerge-branch' and is Task 8 (last of 8 tasks). summary-comment.md confirms: '| 8 | Merge feature branch TC-9005 to main | trustify-backend | main | Bookend (merge-branch) |'

assertion_results.text: All intermediate tasks (between the create-branch and merge-branch bookend tasks) have Target Branch set to TC-9005

The merge-branch bookend task has Target Branch set to main

All non-documentation intermediate tasks list the create-branch bookend task as a dependency. Documentation tasks may list implementation tasks as dependencies instead of the create-branch bookend task, since documentation depends on implementation completion
assertion_results.evidence: Non-documentation intermediate tasks all list Task 1 as a dependency: task-2 (line 67: 'Depends on: Task 1'), task-3 (line 67: 'Depends on: Task 1'), task-4 (line 62: 'Depends on: Task 1'), task-5 (line 68: 'Depends on: Task 1'), task-6 (line 53: 'Depends on: Task 1'). Documentation task-7 lists implementation tasks (Tasks 2-6) as dependencies instead, which is permitted.

assertion_results.text: The merge-branch bookend task lists all non-documentation intermediate tasks as dependencies
assertion_results.evidence: task-8-merge-feature-branch.md Dependencies section (lines 36-42) lists all non-documentation intermediate tasks: Task 2 (migration), Task 3 (entity definitions), Task 4 (service/endpoints), Task 5 (ingestion), Task 6 (tests). It also lists Task 7 (documentation), which is not required but does not invalidate the assertion.

assertion_results.text: Each non-documentation task file contains all required template sections: Repository, Target Branch, Description, at least one of Files to Modify or Files to Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements. Documentation tasks are exempt from requiring Files to Modify, Files to Create, and Implementation Notes — they must still include Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements
assertion_results.evidence: Bookend tasks 1 and 8 are non-documentation task files that lack required sections. task-1-create-feature-branch.md has Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements but is missing Files to Modify/Files to Create and Implementation Notes. task-8-merge-feature-branch.md similarly has Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements but is missing Files to Modify/Files to Create and Implementation Notes. The assertion only exempts documentation tasks, not bookend tasks. Intermediate implementation tasks 2-6 all have the complete required sections. Documentation task 7 meets its reduced requirements (Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements).

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9005 has Priority: High. impact-map.md Field Inheritance section states: 'Priority: High (inherited from Feature TC-9005, propagated to all created tasks and Epics)'. summary-comment.md Inherited Field Values section states: 'Priority: High — inherited from Feature TC-9005 and propagated to all created tasks.' Both files include additional_fields JSON with '"priority": {"name": "High"}'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9005 has fixVersions: RHTPA 2.0.0. No fixVersion scope config exists in CLAUDE.md Jira Field Defaults, defaulting to 'both'. impact-map.md Field Inheritance states: 'fixVersions: RHTPA 2.0.0 (inherited from Feature TC-9005; no `fixVersion scope` setting in Jira Field Defaults — defaulting to "both", propagated to all created tasks and Epics)'. summary-comment.md states: 'fixVersions: RHTPA 2.0.0 — inherited from Feature TC-9005 and propagated to all created tasks. The Feature has a non-empty fixVersions array, and no `fixVersion scope` setting exists in Jira Field Defaults (defaulting to "both"), so fixVersions are propagated to tasks.' Both files include '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 2.0.0"}]' in additional_fields JSON.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in the outputs directory with an '## Inherited Field Values' section documenting: Priority: High inherited from Feature TC-9005 and propagated to all tasks, fixVersions: RHTPA 2.0.0 inherited and propagated, with additional_fields JSON block. impact-map.md also contains a '## Field Inheritance' section with the same information.
